insights.concise_text: MPAD addresses the limited application of the MP framework to representation learning on text by representing documents as word co-occurrence networks and developing an expressive MP GNN.

triple.subject: MPAD
triple.object: the limited application of the MP framework to representation learning on text

insights.concise_text: Because MP iterations correspond to network depth and basic MPAD uses two MP iterations ($T$=2), basic MPAD has depth two.

triple.subject: basic MPAD
triple.object: network depth two

insights.concise_text: With two MP iterations ($T$=2), basic MPAD final vertex representations are based on messages propagated from subtrees of height 2 rooted at each vertex.

triple.subject: basic MPAD with $T$=2
triple.object: final vertex representations based on subtrees of height 2

insights.concise_text: The multi-readout applied to all time steps takes into account local and global features because node features capture more and more global information as one iterates.

triple.subject: multi-readout applied to all time steps
triple.object: local and global features to be taken into account

insights.concise_text: The special document node linked to all other nodes via unit weight bi-directional edges is the master node vector that bypasses the attention mechanism.

triple.subject: special document node
triple.object: master node vector that bypasses the attention mechanism

insights.concise_text: The master node skip connection directly injects global information about the document into its final representation because the special document node is linked to all other nodes.
